title: Naviator heaven
text: LT was knowledgeable about history and the region. It was nice to have a private guide to ask our questions
author: Penny_S

title: Scenic sites of the Alhambra while walking through Sacromonte
text: I enjoyed this tour especially for the many stops at viewpoints of the Alhambra along the way! The history was interesting of Sacromonte  and seeing where families lived in the white washed houses carved out of the caves was beyond imagination! I also saw a Flamenco show in one of the caves later that night!
author: T9223RRjeffreyb

title: So memorable!
text: Would have been so lost without guide. Impossible to navigate complicated street layouts and GPS not helpful with very little internet available in the hills and around cave houses. Would definitely recommend.
author: LightPacker541835

title: Walking tour
text: Such a great way of exploring the city on foot. Lovely informative guide and spectacular view points too!
author: G9533NCkarenm

title: Leisurely walk uphill...
text: Leisurely walk uphill with lots if stops to rest.  Guide was very personable.  Go inside office to check in instead of looking for guide outside.
author: Lindy_H

title: Fun tour - lots of hills and steps!
text: Great tour of two famous Granada neighborhoods, with a nice mix of history, human interest, and Pionono pastries. The tour guide was excellent. Get ready for steps and hills as you go up and down the hillside, but the views are spectacular.
author: Dave_S

title: Not to be missed! Beautiful tour
text: I had a private tour that was worth it, filled with history, beautiful viewpoints, and a typical dessert with Mario! Excellent guide and when you are in Granada for just 1 day it is really a must-do. I highly recommend him ☺️ and also at the agency's reception I was really well served by friendly and smiling people! thanks again
author: nancylV8519YK

title: Perfect walking tour!
text: We had an amazing time with Mario. He was patient and kind, and very knowledgeable. He took his time explaining things to us, and clearly had a very deep understanding of Granada’s history and the local cultures which is exactly what we wanted. Because of his connections, we spoke with locals and he pointed out small businesses and family homes along the way too. Not only did we have a fantastic tour guide, we made a friend! Thank you Mario!
author: carolinebD2368QL

title: Views!!
text: LT was wonderful! He was able to easily explain lots of history in Granada. We felt like locals walking with him, would highly recommend this 2 hour tour. There are lots of stair but the guides provided time to rest and admire the views.
author: Paige_S

title: Walking tour
text: The guide was friendly and informative. He took time explaining the history of Granada and was welcoming and jovial. We learned a lot!
author: Sharon_M
